subject: Holiday order
body: We're gearing up for the holiday markets and need to stock up.
Please send 40 bundles of the heavy 12x12x12 boxes and 10 rolls of the 30 inch kraft paper.

truth.handling: The order comes to $2,048.00 and the account has $578.00 of open credit with an invoice past due, so it's held for credit to review. The reply says it's on hold, without promising a ship date.
